challenges.title: Literal Robot
challenges.blurb: Tell a super-literal robot how to make breakfast. Skip a step and it gets silly.
challenges.pipIntro: Meet Bolt! Bolt does EXACTLY what you say. Can you help it make a bowl of cereal?

steps.label: Get a bowl
steps.disaster: No bowl? Bolt pours the cereal straight onto the table. Crunchy crumbs everywhere!

steps.label: Pour in the cereal
steps.disaster: Bolt never adds the cereal, so you get a bowl of plain milk.

steps.label: Pour in the milk
steps.disaster: No milk? Bolt hands you a bowl of dry cereal and a sad robot face.

challenges.opponentPrompt: Pour cereal in a bowl. Eat it!

challenges.title: Literal Robot
challenges.blurb: Give Bolt 4 must-have steps for ramen. Skip one and it gets messy.
challenges.pipIntro: Meet Bolt. Bolt does EXACTLY what you say and nothing else. Help it make lunch!
challenges.task: Make a bowl of instant ramen in the microwave

steps.label: Take the noodles out of the plastic wrapper
steps.disaster: Bolt microwaves the noodles still sealed in plastic. The bag puffs up like a balloon and goes POP.

steps.label: Put the noodles in a microwave-safe bowl
steps.disaster: No bowl? Bolt drops the noodle brick right on the microwave plate. It spins around like a tiny DJ turntable.

steps.label: Add water until the noodles are covered
steps.disaster: No water, so Bolt heats the dry brick. You get one hot, extra-crunchy noodle cracker.

steps.label: Turn the microwave on for about 3 minutes
steps.disaster: Bolt puts the bowl inside, closes the door, waves goodbye and walks away. It never turned it on. Cold noodle soup!

challenges.opponentPrompt: 1. Put the noodles in a bowl. 2. Add water. 3. Microwave for 3 minutes.
